overall_summary: The channel's highest-performing content centers on extreme cosmic anomalies and space paradoxes characterized by vivid, contrasting sensory imagery (e.g., 'Burning Ice', 'Darker Than Coal', 'Rains Molten Iron'). Conversely, generic psychology hacks and repetitive brain-related facts struggle to capture attention, showing significantly lower baseline views.

winning_patterns.pattern: Extreme Cosmic Anomalies with Sensory Contrast
winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet of Burning Ice Will Break Your Brain!' (vWd0uYcEGh4) achieved 1,055 views, and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) reached 953 views. These titles combine extreme physical properties with strong visual/sensory contrasts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on space anomalies, focusing on planets or stars with physics-defying, highly visual characteristics.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Why Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet' at 19 seconds (c_ya3kvpuoI) generated 262 views, whereas the shorter 13-second version (YBBjFLVhWSw) only managed 52 views. The extra time allows for a clearer, more satisfying scientific payoff.
winning_patterns.action: Target a 18-21 second duration for complex topics to ensure the explanation doesn't feel rushed, improving retention.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A) got 5 views, and 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' (mGEgENcGcNE) got 38 views. These concepts are oversaturated and lack visual novelty.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from standard psychological tricks unless they can be framed through a dramatic, narrative-driven historical or medical mystery lens.

next_video.reason: Capitalizes on the proven success of extreme space anomalies, using high-contrast cosmic visuals and a strong existential hook to maximize retention.

experiment: Test a 'What-If' space scenario formatted as a cinematic micro-story (e.g., 'What If the Moon Was Only 100 Miles Away?') to see if narrative-driven geography/space crossovers can match the high performance of pure planetary facts.
